<h1>Duty Arp</h1>

## Purpose

Modulate each row's **note duty cycle** with a short cyclic pattern (up to
8 values, independent length per row), instead of a fixed per-step value.

## Interaction

Two-stage editor. **LHS LP**: overview of all 8 rows' arp patterns (lit =
active step, position colour = playing step, dark = beyond arp length),
and the row/length selector. **RHS LP**: value editor for the selected row
(column = arp step 1–8, row = value 0–7). Each RHS column shows one lit pad
at the stored value's height, not a filled bar; steps past the length keep
showing their value in slate.

## Shortcuts

### LHS: overview side

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press row R, col N | LP LHS | Select row R; a double-tap within 350 ms sets its length to N slots | none |
| SHIFT + press row R, col N | LP LHS | Select row R and set its length to N slots immediately | shift |
| Press row R, col 9 | LP LHS col 9 | Select row R without changing its length | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press row R, col 9 | LP LHS col 9 | **Reset**: fill the pressed row's arp with `4`, the duty identity (`1/16`, one whole step) | shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press col 9 | LP LHS col 9 | **Randomise**: selected arp fully random across values 0–7 | shift+solo |

### RHS: value editor

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press | LP RHS | Write the pressed row's value into the selected row's arp step (column 0–7) | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press row R | LP RHS | **Reset**: fill selected arp with row R's value | shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press row R | LP RHS | **Randomise**: selected arp gaussian around row R | shift+solo |

A stored length of 0 means one active slot, not disabled playback. Column 1
therefore parks the row on its first duty value. There is no off state for a
duty arp: after a reset that first slot holds the identity value, which is
why it behaves as "no arp".
